messages:
alex: quick question — i'm proposing we add a lightweight hint header so clients can make smarter retry/backoff decisions for per-route vs org quotas. thinking name `x-rw-quota-hint`. thoughts?

maria: big +1 on a hint header. prefer a compact k=v;... style rather than JSON in the header so older SDKs can parse easily. e.g. `limit=120;used=80;window_ms=60000;burst=20`

chen: fwiw many clients currently only look at `Retry-After`. if the hint is only present on 429s it's less useful. can we include it on 2xx/4xx/5xx responses?

samir: agree — include on all responses. then SDKs can proactively smooth traffic instead of getting surprised by a 429. :thumbsup:

alex: example payloads i had in mind:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-rw-quota-hint: limit=120;used=80;window_ms=60000;burst=20
```
or on error:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-quota-hint: limit=120;used=120;window_ms=60000;burst=0
Retry-After: 30
```

maria: small question — when limits are applied at different scopes (route vs org), how do we surface that? include `scope=route` or `scope=org` and maybe `route=/v1/chat`? keep header short though.

alex: yeah include `scope=route` or `scope=org`. optional `route=` when scope=route. example: `limit=120;used=110;window_ms=60000;burst=5;scope=route;route=/v1/embeddings`

taylor: from SDK side, backward-compat is key: don't change 429 body. treat this header as advisory. SDK behavior suggestion: if header present, do immediate retries up to `burst`, otherwise run exponential backoff with jitter.

chen: agreed. also add server-side rule: always include header for responses served by quota logic, even when fallback models are returned. helps clients adjust.

ops-bot: heads-up: will enable canary to start adding header for hosted-first only. Private/Dedicated will be opt-in via feature flag for now.

maria: action items: (1) alex to write RFC with header spec + examples, (2) taylor to add SDK parsing + tests, (3) eng-infra to add feature-flagged rollout, (4) update api contract doc snippet.

alex: i'll open the RFC this afternoon: https://go/repo/rfcs/NNN — pinging @taylor @chen for SDK & infra timelines.

taylor: aiming for SDK PR this week. will add opt-in flag `parseQuotaHint=true` so users can opt-in before we flip-on globally.

samir: nit: `x-rw-quota-hint` ok, but consider `x-redwood-quota` for clarity in external docs. minor tho.

maria: `x-rw-` keeps header short and consistent with other internal headers. fine by me.

alex: consensus seems fine. i'll include an envoy filter example in the RFC for how we populate the header:
```
envoy_filter:
  response_headers_to_add:
    - header: { key: "x-rw-quota-hint", value: "%RESPONSE_QUOTA%" }
```

chen: please add Dedicated/Private migration notes: feature flag + docs + API contract note.

alex: will do. thanks all — i'll post the RFC link when ready. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks — closing thread unless new objections.
